<color=#98cbff>一、超级周末专属特权</color>\n<colo:
<color=#98cbff>I. Super Weekend Perks</color>
<color=#FFFFFF>Super Weekend is here! During the event: all Chessplayers are free to use, Shared Score has no Intimacy requirement, and the first 3 team matches each day grant bonus Intimacy.</color>

<color=#98cbff>II. Perk Details</color>
<color=#FFFFFF>1. All Chessplayers Free
All Chessplayers are free to use during the event. Select your Chessplayer during the event period to enjoy this perk for that match.

2. Shared Score Without Intimacy Requirements
During the event, players with 0-5000 Honor points can enable Shared Score in team Ranked matches without meeting friend Intimacy requirements.
Each player's rank points gained in the match will match those of the highest-placing teammate. Start your match during the event period to enjoy this perk.
This perk is unavailable if anyone on the team has more than 5000 Honor points.

3. Team Intimacy Bonus
During the event, players of all ranks earn double Intimacy for their first 3 matches each day with each friend: an extra 6 per Ranked match or 4 per Normal or Casual match. Each friend has a separate daily limit of 3 matches; matches with different friends do not share the limit.
Finish the match during the event period to enjoy this perk. No extra Intimacy is granted after reaching the weekly limit.</color>

<color=#98cbff>I. Keuntungan Super Weekend</color>
<color=#FFFFFF>Super Weekend tiba! Selama event: semua Chessplayer gratis digunakan, Shared Score tanpa syarat Intimacy, dan 3 pertandingan tim pertama setiap hari memberi bonus Intimacy.</color>

<color=#98cbff>II. Rincian Keuntungan</color>
<color=#FFFFFF>1. Semua Chessplayer Gratis
Semua Chessplayer gratis digunakan selama event. Pilih Chessplayer saat event berlangsung untuk menikmati keuntungan ini dalam pertandingan tersebut.

2. Shared Score Tanpa Syarat Intimacy
Selama event, pemain dengan 0-5000 poin Honor dapat mengaktifkan Shared Score dalam Ranked tim tanpa memenuhi syarat Intimacy pertemanan.
Poin rank yang didapat setiap pemain akan sama dengan rekan satu tim yang menempati peringkat tertinggi. Mulai pertandingan saat event berlangsung untuk menikmati keuntungan ini.
Keuntungan ini tidak berlaku jika ada anggota tim dengan poin Honor di atas 5000.

3. Bonus Intimacy Tim
Selama event, pemain di semua rank mendapat Intimacy ganda untuk 3 pertandingan pertama setiap hari bersama setiap teman: tambahan 6 per pertandingan Ranked atau 4 per pertandingan Normal atau Casual. Setiap teman memiliki batas harian 3 pertandingan tersendiri; pertandingan bersama teman berbeda tidak berbagi batas.
Selesaikan pertandingan saat event berlangsung untuk menikmati keuntungan ini. Tidak ada tambahan Intimacy setelah mencapai batas mingguan.</color>
